projects.name: Front Bumper Assembly
projects.description:
Our capacity is limited to 8242 p/w in LCV LINE.  This MAX LCV Volume includes AC+AP+OV+AF Volumes shared by Stellantis and is limited to 7450 p/week.

This capacity for LCV Line (8242 p/week) is related to 5 days production working on high cadence [evacuating prts through CRM to Vigo Plant + TILTING MACHINES to Long Range Synchronous Flows( MG+ EP+ Algeria + Tunisia)]+ 5 extra shifts working ONLY on  35 p/h using TILTING MACHINES to Long Range Synchronous Flows( MG+ EP+ Algeria + Tunisia)] . The bottleneck is the packaging in racks used for Mangualde+ Ellesmere Port + Algeria + Tunisia;  due to the cycle time of  tilting machines. This flow implies that for each hour less in vigo we have a reduction of total capacity being limited to 35 p/h ( Global Line: using ONLY TILTING Machine).
